scope: Native Musimotion development UI. The examples are synthetic. Each WebP is a crop of a genuine XCTest screenshot. Captions identify the platform and source workflow.

images.alt: Music Studio on Mac with Import AI Score and Done above the music brief
images.caption: In this Mac development build, Import AI Score… sits at the top of Music Studio. It opens the system file picker.
images.source_attachment: Template Gallery AI music - 01 Find Import AI Score

images.alt: Mac Music Studio playing the eight-second external Lantern Pulse score at 120 BPM, with Stop Preview and Add to Scene available
images.caption: The Mac preview is playing a synthetic Codex-authored score. The source reads External AI score. Lantern Pulse runs for 8.0 seconds at 120 BPM.
images.source_attachment: Template Gallery AI music - 02 Audition the external score

images.alt: Objects list on Mac with Lantern Pulse selected below the Welcome and Orb layers
images.caption: After Add to Scene, the Mac Objects list shows Lantern Pulse as a selected audio layer.
images.source_attachment: Template Gallery AI music - 03 External score in the presentation

images.alt: AI Creation Studio on iPad asking what subject or words should appear, with Your direction, Use Answer and Use My Brief
images.caption: The iPad simulator asks one question after “Make something.” Enter a direction to enable Use Answer, or continue with Use My Brief.
images.source_attachment: Template Gallery AI creation - 01 Clarify the brief

images.alt: iPad editable steering plan for Lantern Festival showing Lower Third, Push In and a ten-second star cue
images.caption: The iPad simulator’s local template planner used the answer to build Lantern Festival with a star layer. This capture shows the template fallback.
images.source_attachment: Template Gallery AI creation - 02 Review the local plan

images.alt: Music Studio on iPad showing the question about the role of the music and Build to a reveal selected
images.caption: For “make some music,” the iPad simulator shows the optional role picker. Build to a reveal gives the planner a musical direction.
images.source_attachment: Template Gallery AI music - 04 Choose a role for the scene

images.alt: AI Creation Studio header on Mac showing the Import AI Draft button
images.caption: In the Mac editor, Import AI Draft… is in the header of AI Creation Studio. The import sheet also links to the companion setup guide.
images.source_attachment: Template Gallery AI creation - 03 Open the draft importer

images.alt: Mac Import AI Draft sheet with invalid JSON, an inline correction, Choose JSON File and Review Draft
images.caption: This synthetic Mac example contains only the word “invalid.” The message asks for a UTF-8 JSON scene plan containing one object. Replace the input or choose a file.
images.source_attachment: Template Gallery AI creation - 04 Correct an invalid draft

images.alt: Mac External AI draft for Lantern Festival showing the timed Lantern star and Closing wish cues, a local reading notice and Add Scene
images.caption: In this synthetic Codex-authored variation, Lantern star rises from 2 to 6 seconds, then Closing wish shows “Make a wish.” The editor identifies the external assistant as the author. The downloadable starter demonstrates the star cue.
images.source_attachment: Template Gallery AI creation - 05 Review the external timed cue

images.alt: Lantern star selected in the Mac Objects list with blue handles on the stage and Star shape, color, scale and rotation in the inspector
images.caption: The new Lantern Festival scene begins after Scene 1. Lantern star has its own editable shape, color and transform controls in the Mac inspector.
images.source_attachment: Template Gallery AI creation - 06 Select the generated object
